From 9648f1c3739505557d94ff749a4f32192ea81fe3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Feb 2022 10:15:04 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
index 13b27b8ff74e..ba21ace973da 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@ static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c`**
   - The line that constructs the `request` array for the `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` function was modified. 
   - The second element of the `request` array, which previously had a value of `2`, was changed to `1`. This reflects the correct parameter count for the SLPC unset parameter H2G, which only requires the ID of the parameter.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `intel_guc_slpc.c` directly addresses a bug related to the parameter count for the SLPC unset parameter. The change ensures that the function correctly specifies the number of parameters needed when making a request to unset a parameter, thereby fixing the issue introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `025cb07bebfa`). This correction is crucial for the proper functioning of the SLPC feature in the Intel graphics driver.

The bug was caused by an incorrect parameter count specified in the `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` function, where it incorrectly indicated that two parameters were needed instead of the correct one (the ID of the parameter). This mismatch could lead to improper handling of requests to unset parameters, potentially causing failures or unexpected behavior in the SLPC functionality.

 static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
 	return intel_guc_send(guc, request, ARRAY_SIZE(request));
 }
